case: 2026-10-08 misroute, sanitized: a request to pilot a new Looker report with 10 GMs, posted with continue_thread into the bonus-calculation automation thread
postText:
Looker report pilot for 10 GMs, Pat
Slack DM · Pat Example · Thu 1:54 PM ET
ASK: Pat has 10 GMs to try the new Looker report for a week; asks if she just sends you their names and locations.
BUCKET: DRAFT (access setup plus a reply for your approval)
https://example.slack.com/archives/D000000002/p1700000000000002

messages.text: @1478986205319135302 https://example.slack.com/archives/C000000001/p1700000000000001 today, Pat manually calculates monthly and quarterly bonuses for our field team at the salons. This message has the spreadsheet that she uses every month and the comp plan rules behind it. Can you draft a plan to automate the GM, DM and RM bonus calculation so the analysts can own it?

Rewrote post 1 as your starting point for them to take over. The work split is gone. Post 2 is unchanged. Post 1 (brief and HTML attached): @Sam @Lee Here's a first pass at a plan for automating the GM, DM and RM bonus calc, based on Pat's file and the comp plans she shared. The HTML walks through the inputs, the rules and a proposed schedule.
Rewrote post 1 as your starting point for them to take over. The work split is gone. Post 2 is unchanged.
@1478986205319135302 don't quote my instruction back to them, just set the tone. They own it from here.

You're right, I pasted your instruction into the message when it should have set the tone. That line is gone, and the questions now carry the handoff. Post 2 is unchanged. Post 1 (brief and HTML attached): @Sam @Lee Here's a first pass at a plan for automating the GM, DM and RM bonus calc.

Sent both in the group DM as you. Post 1 to Sam and Lee has the plan HTML and the brief attached. Post 2 asks Pat the four rule questions about rounding, proration and the quarterly true-up. Verified: read back from Slack, both posts as Dave, both files attached.
Sent both in the group DM as you. Post 1 to Sam and Lee has the plan HTML and the brief attached.

instructions.question: Is `candidate_thread` already working on the same request as `new_message`, meaning the same deliverable or the same open question, so that `new_message` should be posted into that thread?

criteria.true: Same request. `new_message` follows up on the specific thing that thread is working on: it answers a question asked there, adds input or files for it, asks for its status, or repeats the same ask.
criteria.false: Different request. The thread works on a different deliverable or question, even if it involves the same person, team, system or subject area.
